audit.whatIsWrong: The prose says 'This is where it turns' at 4-5 and 'You stay favoured into him' late, while the level chart on the same page gives Tahm Kench four of seven stages and Malphite none. Separately, the two sides of this matchup disagree in the source data: this packet has Malphite at 53.69% over 948 games, and audits/top/tahmkench__malphite.json has Tahm Kench at 53.03% over 1684 games. Both cannot be true.
audit.why: The chart agrees with the mirror's direction, so I have left it and the 'favoured' wording alone rather than swing a verdict on contradictory numbers — but the reasons underneath the verdict were wrong and those I did fix. Raised as a question rather than guessed.
audit.corrected: Chart left as-is (Tahm-leaning, consistent with the mirror). The supporting mechanics rewritten. Win-rate conflict escalated.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[3], wants.you[1], late, whys[5] and whys[6] all build the item spike on stacking armour 'into his AD-light kit', claiming it neutralises him.
audit.why: It is true that Tahm Kench has almost no AD scaling, but the conclusion drawn from it is backwards. An Acquired Taste scales his damage off his own total health, and Tongue Lash, Abyssal Dive and Devour all deal magic damage — armour reduces none of it. Armour is still correct to buy, for the reason the entry never gives: Ground Slam's damage is calculated from Malphite's Armor. Defensively the buys are MR and Grievous Wounds, because Tongue Lash heals him on champion hit and Thick Skin turns stored damage into a shield or out-of-combat healing.
audit.corrected: Armour is an offensive stat here (Ground Slam scales off it). MR and Grievous Wounds are the defensive answer — Tongue Lash heals and Thick Skin converts damage you deal into his shield.
sources: champ-data/_kits/tahmkench.json (P An Acquired Taste, Q heal, E Thick Skin shield/heal)

audit.whatIsWrong: The entry has Tahm Kench's ability slots wrong in six places. 'Grey-health W' and 'W devour' and 'his W grey health converts back to real HP' all point at W; grey health is Thick Skin, which is E, and Devour is R. wants.foe[1] then invents an ability outright: 'R Abyssal Voyage'.
audit.why: W is Abyssal Dive — a 21s-at-rank-1 dive that knocks up on arrival, from 1000 range. That is his engage and his reposition, and the entry never mentions it once, while attributing its slot to two other abilities. Abyssal Voyage is not in his kit at all. A player told to watch W for grey health will be watching the wrong button when the knock-up lands on him.
audit.corrected: W is Abyssal Dive: 1000 range, 21s at rank 1, knocks up on arrival. E is Thick Skin: stores a percentage of damage taken, heals it back out of combat or converts it to a shield on a 3s cooldown. R is Devour, 100 mana, which eats an enemy champion or shields an ally.
sources: champ-data/_kits/tahmkench.json (W Abyssal Dive cd 21/20/19/18/17 range 1000; E Thick Skin cd 3; R Devour)

audit.whatIsWrong: Five strings treat Tongue Lash as a free stun from level 1 — 'his tongue (Q) stun', 'Land tongue (Q) stuns', 'a Q he can stun you out of', 'eating Q stuns'.
audit.why: Tongue Lash does not stun on its own. Riot's text: it damages and slows the first unit hit, heals him against champions, and applies a stack of An Acquired Taste — and only if the champion already has three stacks does it stun. The stun is the payoff for three prior hits, and it consumes the same three stacks Devour needs. That is the whole counterplay: deny stacks and the stun never exists, and every stack he spends on a stun is one he cannot spend on Devour.
audit.corrected: Tongue Lash slows; it stuns only at three An Acquired Taste stacks, and spending them on the stun is spending them instead of Devour. Break the stack timer and there is no stun.
sources: champ-data/_kits/tahmkench.json (P An Acquired Taste; Q Tongue Lash, cd 7/6.5/6/5.5/5, range 900)

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing states the range gap. The entry advises 'last-hit at max range' as if that were safety.
audit.why: Tongue Lash is 900. Seismic Shard is 625, Thunderclap 400, Ground Slam 400. Your max range is inside his — there is no distance at which you farm safely and he cannot chip you. The mirror entry reaches the same conclusion from the other side.
audit.corrected: Tongue Lash reaches 900 against Seismic Shard's 625 and Ground Slam's 400 — every range is his range, so the plan is Granite Shield resets, not spacing.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[2] claims Unstoppable Force gives 'all-in pressure he can't match' with no cooldowns attached.
audit.why: Unstoppable Force is 130s at rank 1; Abyssal Dive is 21s at rank 1. He gets six repositions for every engage you get. Framing your ultimate as the pressure he cannot match, without that ratio, invites spending a 130s cooldown on a fight he can simply dive away from and re-enter. The mirror entry states the same ratio from his side.
audit.corrected: Unstoppable Force 130/115/100s against Abyssal Dive's 21s at rank 1 — he gets several to your one, so R is a commit, never a poke.

edits.before: Tahm Kench owns the opening here — his tongue (Q) stun plus grey-health passive and W devour let him eat your Seismic Shard (Q) poke and answer with a trade you can't sustain before Thunderclap is online. Don't walk up to throw a Q he can stun you out of; last-hit at max range and use Q's move-speed steal to disengage if he steps up for a tongue. You have no real trade pattern yet, so concede a little CS and just survive — his early grey health means poke barely sticks anyway.
edits.after: Tahm Kench owns the opening. Tongue Lash reaches 900 against Seismic Shard's 625, so there is no range at which you farm and he cannot chip you — and it heals him on every champion hit. The stun is not free: Tongue Lash only stuns at three An Acquired Taste stacks, and each stack comes off a hit. Break the timer and the stun never exists. Thick Skin (E) is the grey health, storing a share of what you deal and giving it back as a shield. Concede a little CS, take the chip, and let Granite Shield recharge between step-ups.

edits.before: This is where it turns. At Levels 4-5 Thunderclap (W) gives you armor and AoE auto splash while Ground Slam (E) slows his attack speed and chunks him, and Granite Shield refreshes every time you back off — now you farm through his grey-health trades instead of eating them. At 6, Unstoppable Force (R) is the all-in he simply can't answer: knock him up, E-W into him, and burst before his W grey health converts back to real HP. Bait his tongue (Q) — once it's down he has no peel for your dive.
edits.after: This is where it turns. At Levels 4-5 Thunderclap (W) gives you armour and aftershocks on your next few autos, and Ground Slam (E) is a flat 7s that cuts his attack speed — which taxes the autos he builds An Acquired Taste with. Granite Shield refreshes every time you break off. At 6, Unstoppable Force is 130s against Abyssal Dive's 21s, so he gets several repositions to your one commit: hold R until his three stacks are spent, because with them he either stuns you or Devours you out of the fight entirely.

edits.before: You stay favoured into him because his kit is percent-HP and grey-health sustain with almost no AD — exactly what your armor stacking neutralizes. Sunfire or Frozen Heart make your E and W trades win outright while his devour chips you for almost nothing. His real threat isn't the 1v1, it's the map: R roam and devouring a diving teammate. Keep your R for teamfights, ward his flanks, and don't let him drag you into a long game where his sustain out-lasts your low damage.
edits.after: You stay favoured, but not for the reason you have been told. His damage is magic and scales off his own health, so armour defends nothing — armour is worth buying because Ground Slam's damage is calculated from it, while MR and Grievous Wounds are what actually blunt him: Tongue Lash heals on hit and Thick Skin hands him back a share of everything you deal. His real threat is the map, not the 1v1 — Devour saves a diving ally outright. Keep R for fights, ward his flanks, refuse the long game.

notes: MIRROR: reused audits/top/tahmkench__malphite.json — Tongue Lash 900 vs Seismic Shard 625, Abyssal Dive 21s against Unstoppable Force 130s, the three-stack Q-stun-or-Devour choice, and Thick Skin as the grey health. Same facts stated from Malphite's side; no direction conflict introduced, and this side's chart already leans Tahm Kench like the mirror's conclusion. BIGGEST FIX: this entry had his ability slots wrong in six places. Grey health was called 'W' (it is Thick Skin, E) and Devour was called 'W devour' (it is R), while W — Abyssal Dive, a 1000-range 21s knock-up dive — was never mentioned at all. wants.foe[1] also named 'R Abyssal Voyage', which is not in his kit. SECOND FIX: five strings treated Tongue Lash as a free stun. It slows; it stuns only at three An Acquired Taste stacks, and those are the same three stacks Devour consumes. THIRD: the armour argument was backwards — his damage is magic and health-scaled, so armour defends nothing; it is an offensive buy because Ground Slam scales off it, and the defensive buys are MR and Grievous Wounds (Tongue Lash heals, Thick Skin recycles your damage into his shield), which _missing-interactions.json flags and the entry never mentioned.
